content.title: What time does Justin Bieber perform at Coachella 2026?
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 8:44 p.m. ETJustin Bieber will perform at 11:25 p.m. PT on Coachella's main stage on Saturday, April 11, 2026. The Coachella headliner will perform at the same time on Saturday, April 18, 2026. during the festival's second weekend.Bieber is headlining Saturday's Coachella lineup, which also includes performances from The Strokes, Addison Rae, David Byrne, Interpol, PinkPantheress, Jack White and Nine Inch Noize.How to Watch Justin Bieber at Coachella 2026Coachella is livestreaming most of Saturday's sets on YouTube. You can also watch via the Coachella Livestream app, which syncs to your time zone.Which songs will Justin Bieber perform at Coachella 2026?This is Bieber's first time headlining Coachella and his first major live set in years.
